title: OpenAI for Healthcare
summary: OpenAI for Healthcare enables secure, enterprise-grade AI that supports HIPAA compliance—reducing administrative burden and supporting clinical workflows.
body: OpenAI for Healthcare enables secure, enterprise-grade AI that supports HIPAA compliance—reducing administrative burden and supporting clinical workflows.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出医疗行业解决方案，支持HIPAA合规性，旨在通过AI自动化减轻医疗行政负担并优化临床工作流。该方案为医疗机构提供了安全的企业级AI应用路径。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI在医疗合规领域的布局，有助于推动AI在敏感行业的工作流自动化。
